wire.t: jmello16 picked up Patriots receiver Mack Hollins Saturday morning and started him. Mike Evans and Marvin Harrison Jr., both ruled Out, are now on the Jefferson’s Reserve bench. Hollins was dropped by Hold My DK on Nov. 8.
The Chiefs downgraded Kenneth Walker III from Questionable to Out on Saturday for Sunday's game at Atlanta. jrsmith1391 moved him to the Catfan94’s Farm Team bench and put Zonovan Knight at flex.
Rookie Emmett Johnson is expected to lead the Kansas City backfield with Walker out. Johnson is on the LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix bench.

The Saints are activating Travis Etienne Jr. from injured reserve for Sunday against Carolina. He's listed Questionable after a full practice Friday and is in the Jefferson’s Reserve starting lineup. He's expected to share work with Alvin Kamara and Audric Estime.
Audric Estime, the $2 waiver add, is on The Champ bench. Alvin Kamara is on the I Chase Brown Kids bench. That's one New Orleans backfield split three fantasy ways.

Still Questionable and still in lineups: Amon-Ra St. Brown (Catfan94’s Farm Team), Garrett Wilson (The Champ), Denzel Boston (StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte), Rhamondre Stevenson (Dude, Your Getting a Dell), Omar Cooper Jr. and Jordan Addison (OBJAY), Adonai Mitchell (I Chase Brown Kids) and Ladd McConkey (Asian Jim).
Nobody in the league has an Out player or a bye-week player in a starting lineup as of Sunday morning.
Thursday's head starts stand: LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix 29.70, I Chase Brown Kids 33.16, OBJAY 28.70, Dude, Your Getting a Dell 17.80, Asian Jim 9.20 and Bourbon Lover 0.30.

stories.title: jmello16 fixes the Jefferson’s Reserve lineup with Mack Hollins, the guy Hold My DK cut
stories.dek: Kenneth Walker III gets ruled Out and jrsmith1391 moves him. Travis Etienne Jr. is back. Every lineup in the league is legal by 7 AM.
body: Credit where it's due. Yesterday Jefferson’s Reserve had Mike Evans and Marvin Harrison Jr. ruled Out and sitting in the lineup with zero healthy receivers on the bench. At 11:13 Saturday morning jmello16 went to free agency, grabbed Mack Hollins, and started him next to Justin Jefferson and Chris Olave. Evans and Harrison are on the bench now. Hollins sat in free agency for about 142 hours after TheMoneyTeam2302 dropped him on Nov. 8, so Jefferson’s Reserve is now starting a Hold My DK reject against LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix. Whatever. It's a body that's playing.

There's more help coming. The Saints are activating Travis Etienne Jr. off IR for Carolina, and he's in the Jefferson’s Reserve lineup as a Questionable after a full practice Friday. He's splitting work with Alvin Kamara (I Chase Brown Kids bench) and Audric Estime (The Champ bench), so don't expect 25 touches. Still down 29.70 to 0.00 to Catfan94, but the line drops from 46.4 to 41.4.

Over on Catfan94’s Farm Team, the Chiefs downgraded Kenneth Walker III to Out on Saturday. That's the guy who scored 36.8 for jrsmith1391 last week. jrsmith1391 already had him on the bench by this morning, with Zonovan Knight in the flex next to Jadarian Price and Breece Hall. Two Saturday-type fixes in two days from the same guy. The line against OBJAY slides from 25.6 to 23.6, and OBJAY still leads 28.70 to 0.00.

And here's the part that'll annoy jrsmith1391: the man replacing Walker in Kansas City is rookie Emmett Johnson, who's sitting on the LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix bench. Catfan94 owns the backup to the other Catfan94-named team's best running back. As of 7 AM nobody in the league is starting an Out player or a bye-week player. I checked twice. I'm as surprised as you are.

stories.title: Nine Questionable starters, and the 1 PM window decides the bottom of the standings
stories.dek: Garrett Wilson, Amon-Ra St. Brown and Denzel Boston headline the list. Inactives come out 90 minutes before kickoff.
body: The Questionable starters going into Sunday: Amon-Ra St. Brown (Catfan94’s Farm Team), Garrett Wilson (The Champ), Denzel Boston (StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte), Rhamondre Stevenson (Dude, Your Getting a Dell), Omar Cooper Jr. and Jordan Addison (OBJAY), Adonai Mitchell (I Chase Brown Kids), Ladd McConkey (Asian Jim) and Travis Etienne Jr. (Jefferson’s Reserve).

Bench options if somebody sits: jrsmith1391 has MarShawn Lloyd and Keaton Mitchell. TJohn91 has A.J. Brown (also Questionable), Keenan Allen and Kayshon Boutte. JAY2913 has Efton Chism III and Tutu Atwell. ZachCarroll09 has Rashod Bateman. ManicOrientals has Tre' Harris and Malachi Fields. I have Devaughn Vele, Konata Mumpfield and Ashton Dulin for Boston.

The stakes at the bottom: StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte, I Chase Brown Kids and Bourbon Lover are all 3‑6. ZachCarroll09 leads paknight12 33.16 to 0.30, so one of them is probably getting to 4‑6 and the other is probably going to 3‑7. I'm a 38.2-point underdog to Hold My DK and would like everyone to stop asking about it.
Br0phy leads The Champ 17.80 to 0.00 and is still a 60.1-point underdog. Dude, Your Getting a Dell has been leading a game for three straight days. Br0phy, take a screenshot before 1 PM.

stories.title: J.J. McCarthy drops 22.12 on the Jefferson’s Reserve bench, and Bill_Buttlicker finally benches Makai Lemon
stories.dek: Washington wins 24-21 on a Stefon Diggs touchdown with 57 seconds left. OBJAY, I Chase Brown Kids and LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix bank the points.
body: Washington beat the Giants 24-21, and the best fantasy performance wasn't in anybody's lineup on the team that needed it. J.J. McCarthy threw for 293 yards and scored 22.12 on the Jefferson’s Reserve bench. That's two weeks in a row: C.J. Stroud had 50.36 on the bench in Week 9, so jmello16 started Stroud this week, and now the other one went off. Stroud plays Sunday, so this one isn't over, but Jefferson’s Reserve is down 29.7 to 0.00 to LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix before kickoff.
That 29.7 is Isaiah Likely, who had 9 catches, 127 yards and a 66-yard touchdown. Catfan94 is 8‑1, a 43.4-point favorite, and got a head start from his tight end. Must be nice.

OBJAY got 28.7 from Cam Skattebo and his two touchdowns, so JAY2913 leads Catfan94’s Farm Team 28.70 to 0.00. Antonio Williams also caught a 31-yard touchdown for Washington and scored 11.7 on OBJAY's taxi squad. I Chase Brown Kids leads Bourbon Lover 33.16 to 0.30 behind Jayden Daniels (27.76, three touchdowns, two picks). Devin Singletary got one carry. Dude, Your Getting a Dell got 17.8 from Stefon Diggs, including the winning touchdown, and leads The Champ 17.80 to 0.00. Br0phy is 0‑9 and has a lead. Screenshot it.

And yes, I fixed it. Makai Lemon is out of the StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte lineup, Chris Rodriguez Jr. and AJ Barner are in, and the league has zero bye-week starters. I'm still a 41.2-point underdog to Hold My DK, Denzel Boston didn't practice Thursday, and Kaleb Johnson and Ashton Dulin are still on my bench. Baby steps.

stories.title: Bill_Buttlicker owns 12 first-round picks, and four contenders own none
stories.dek: The picks through 2029 are lopsided, and the standings are too.
body: Counting 2027 through 2029, StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte owns 12 first-round picks, which is a full first round's worth of picks. JAY2913 is next with six on OBJAY, then ZachCarroll09 with five on I Chase Brown Kids and Br0phy with four on Dude, Your Getting a Dell.

Kraft for Cash, Catfan94’s Farm Team, LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix and Hold My DK own zero first-round picks over that stretch, and they are the top four teams in the standings. That's a bet on now, and it's working while the whole group is 6‑3 or better.
The risk is that all four teams are on the wrong side of a rebuild in three years, and the one with 12 first-round picks is 3‑6 with 27-72 all-play. Tyler's plan is a long one.

feature.title: Week 9: Catfan94’s Farm Team drops 180.30, The Champ takes the bad beat, and Dude, Your Getting a Dell is 0‑9
body: Catfan94’s Farm Team beat Jefferson’s Reserve 180.30 to 82.92, a 97.38-point margin and the biggest of the week. Kenneth Walker III had 36.8, Brock Purdy 31.28, Christian Watson 28.6 and Bucky Irving 27.5. jrsmith1391 is 6‑3 and has won two straight.

LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix beat The Champ 164.84 to 127.74. Jordan Love scored 42.18, Ja'Marr Chase 30.0 and Brock Bowers 24.3, and Catfan94 is 8‑1 with five wins in a row. TJohn91 had the highest losing score of the week and still lost by 37.10. Josh Jacobs scored -0.5 in the lineup, and Boutte (29.5) and Matthew Stafford (13.22) sat on the bench.

Hold My DK beat Bourbon Lover 147.12 to 86.20 behind Puka Nacua at 32.5 and Christian McCaffrey at 23.7. Kraft for Cash beat I Chase Brown Kids 121.74 to 99.86, and Asian Jim beat Dude, Your Getting a Dell 86.00 to 68.34, which is the lowest score of the week. Br0phy is 0‑9.

StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte beat OBJAY 115.16 to 108.88 by 6.28, the closest game of the week. Bill_Buttlicker is 3‑6 with Drake Maye at 24.76. JAY2913 had Efton Chism III on the bench with 14.4, and swapping him in for Emeka Egbuka (6.4) would have won it 116.88 to 115.16.

rumors.t: Mack Hollins reportedly showed up to Jefferson’s Reserve still wearing a Hold My DK lanyard. jmello16 told him to flip it over.
TheMoneyTeam2302 has reportedly asked Sleeper for a 'drop-back fee' every time someone picks up a player Hold My DK cut. Sleeper said that's just called free agency.
Emmett Johnson reportedly texted Catfan94 'I'm starting for the Chiefs today' and Catfan94 replied 'not for me you're not.'

trades.why: Josh Jacobs is on IR and TJohn91 already has Audric Estime, so why not own two-thirds of the New Orleans backfield now that Travis Etienne Jr. is back. ZachCarroll09 is 3‑6 and gets a 24-year-old receiver who scored 29.5 on a bench.
TheMoneyTeam2302 has Brian Robinson Jr. and James Conner on IR and needs running back depth (Jones Sr. is 31). paknight12 is 3‑6 and gets Isaiah Bond (22) off the Hold My DK taxi squad.

Kyler Murray is Out, and ManicOrientals could use a 23-year-old quarterback who just scored 22.12. jmello16 has five quarterbacks and needs running back depth behind Travis Etienne Jr., who's just coming off IR.
Bill_Buttlicker has Jalen Hurts on IR and wants a second young quarterback, and ZachCarroll09 has six of them. Cam Ward (24) for Denzel Boston (22).

Jefferson’s Reserve just had to start a free agent with Mike Evans, Marvin Harrison Jr. and Jaylen Waddle Out, and it has five quarterbacks. Bourbon Lover has Lamar Jackson and Sam Darnold on IR and is starting Drew Lock at superflex. Each side sends what it has too much of.

Bill_Buttlicker sends a 24-year-old franchise quarterback to OBJAY for a 36-year-old, on a team with 12 first-round picks and a rebuild. JAY2913 would get Drake Maye and keep Kyle McCord. Tyler is roasting himself again.
Catfan94 sends the best receiver in the league to an 0‑9 team for a quarterback who scored -2.76 in Week 9. Both commissioners would have to look away.
Catfan94 gives up a 24-year-old star running back for the guy who got one carry Thursday night. LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix is 8‑1 and this would be its first loss of the week.

columns.title: Every lineup in this league is legal. Don't get used to it.
columns.dek: Two managers did their jobs on Saturday. The standings don't hand out points for that.
body: Here's the scorecard for Saturday. jmello16 had two Out receivers in his lineup and fixed it with a free agent. jrsmith1391 lost Kenneth Walker III to a downgrade and fixed it with Zonovan Knight. As of Sunday morning, not one team in this league is starting an Out player or a bye-week player. That's the minimum, and I'm still going to say it out loud because it's rare.

Now the part nobody wants to hear. Fixing the lineup on Saturday doesn't fix the roster. Jefferson’s Reserve has five quarterbacks and had to start a receiver Hold My DK didn't want. That's a construction problem. jmello16 should be shopping J.J. McCarthy or Kirk Cousins for a receiver this week, not checking free agency at 11 in the morning.

And jrsmith1391, you've got zero first-round picks through 2029 and a running back room that just lost its best player for a week. Walker had 36.8 last week, about a quarter of your 149.9 average. You're 6‑3. If you're buying, buy now.

As for me reading the bottom of the standings: StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte, I Chase Brown Kids and Bourbon Lover are all 3‑6, and one of the last two gets to 4‑6 today. Tyler's a 38.2-point underdog. Legal lineup. Same result.

columns.title: 5 Sunday morning tips from Holden McGroin, who set his lineup in August and walked away
columns.dek: Holden is writing this from the porch. The coffee is cold. So is the advice.
body: 1. Never pick up a free agent another team dropped. They know something. jmello16 took Mack Hollins off the Hold My DK scrap pile and now Jefferson’s Reserve is legal. Coincidence? Probably.
2. Bench your best running back the day before the game. jrsmith1391 did it with Kenneth Walker III and his team is still a 23.6-point favorite. Benching works. Do it to everybody.

3. Roster the backup, not the starter. Catfan94 has Emmett Johnson on the LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix bench, and Johnson is starting for Kansas City today. Catfan94 still isn't starting him, which is the advanced version of this tip.

4. Split backfields are a bargain. The Saints running backs are on three different teams in this league: Travis Etienne Jr. (Jefferson’s Reserve), Alvin Kamara (I Chase Brown Kids) and Audric Estime (The Champ). If you own all three, you own one running back. Math.
5. If you're a 38.2-point underdog like Bill_Buttlicker, don't watch. The points can't see you.

columns.title: Mack Hollins spent 142 hours in free agency. My model calls that an apprenticeship.
columns.dek: Ivana has a new spreadsheet. It has one row. The row is Mack Hollins.
body: TheMoneyTeam2302 dropped Mack Hollins at 1:02 PM ET on Nov. 8. jmello16 added him at 11:13 AM ET on Nov. 14. That's about 142 hours of free agency, or 5.9 days, or 0.84 weeks of Hollins being nobody's problem. By my model, a player who sits unclaimed for 0.84 weeks comes back 84% hungrier.

Jefferson’s Reserve went from two Out players in the lineup to zero overnight. That's a 100% improvement in legality, the biggest single-day gain in the league this year. The spread only moved from 46.4 to 41.4, which is 10.8%. The other 89.2% is LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix being good.

Kenneth Walker III scored 36.8 for Catfan94’s Farm Team last week, which is 24.5% of the team's 149.9 average. jrsmith1391 replaced him with Zonovan Knight. If Knight scores 24.5% of anything, the model counts it as a wash.

Finally, the New Orleans backfield is spread across three fantasy teams with a combined record of 12‑15. That's 0.444, which my model says is exactly the winning percentage of a running back committee. I've never been more right about anything.

exits.t: One of five quarterbacks on the Jefferson’s Reserve roster, and jmello16 went to free agency for Mack Hollins instead of trading one of them for a receiver. Would like to be the one traded next time.
Caught a 31-yard touchdown Thursday and scored 11.7 on OBJAY's taxi squad, where points don't count. Wants a roster spot that counts.
Scored 14.3 on the bench in Week 9 and is still on the bench in Week 10, even after Bill_Buttlicker finally fixed the bye-week spot. Wants a manager who checks the depth chart.
Scored 14.4 on the bench in a 6.28-point loss in Week 9, and he's on the bench again with Emeka Egbuka and Luther Burden III on bye.
Scored 29.5 on the bench in Week 9 and still isn't starting for The Champ. Wants a team that reads its own box scores.
Scored 16.48 on the bench in Week 9 behind Josh Allen and Jordan Love. Wants a starting job somewhere, preferably on a team without two better quarterbacks.
